title: Best Laptop Under ₹50,000 in India (2026): Specs Decoded, Real Picks
description: Buying a laptop under ₹50,000 in India is confusing — too many options, specs that lie. Here's what actually matters and the 5 models worth buying.
short_desc: Spec sheets decoded — pick by use, not by brand.

headings.text: What actually matters in a laptop under ₹50,000
Pick by use case, not by brand

cta.headline: Not sure what specs you need?
cta.sub: Tell us what you'll use it for — we'll recommend the exact model.

faq.q: Should I buy Intel or AMD?
faq.a: AMD wins in this segment. Ryzen 5 (5500U, 5600H) and Ryzen 7 (5700U) outperform equivalent Intel i5/i7 chips on both performance and battery.

faq.q: How much RAM do I need?
faq.a: 8GB is the minimum in 2026 — Chrome alone eats 4GB. 16GB is ideal but rare under ₹50,000.
For studying, coding, browsing, and even light photo editing — yes. For gaming or video editing, you need a dedicated GPU.
